G3_faithfulness.justification: The rewrite preserves the tree-edge placement problem and budget condition, although replacing the original hierarchy and loop-free formulation with connectivity plus exactly n−1 interactions leaves minor ambiguity about duplicate or self-loop edges.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is generally fluent and readable, though phrases such as “globally integrated system” and “strictly minimal to prevent redundant dependencies” are somewhat artificial.
